# async_redux

**Tag**: redux, state-management, ui, reactive-programming, testing

## 简介

The modern version of Redux. State management that's simple to learn and easy to use; Powerful enough to handle complex applications with millions of users; Testable.

## 官网

- 主页: https://asyncredux.com
- 源码仓库: https://github.com/marcglasberg/async_redux
- 问题追踪: https://github.com/marcglasberg/async_redux/issues
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/async_redux
